nodes.description: Heterozygous loss-of-function of TWIST1 (nonsense, missense within the bHLH domain, insertions/deletions, or whole-gene deletions) reduces functional TWIST1 dosage. TWIST1 is a bHLH transcription factor required in head mesenchyme; its haploinsufficiency removes the anti-osteogenic restraint that keeps the coronal suture patent. This initiates the boundary/niche-loss route into the conserved cranial-suture premature-fusion endpoint, mechanistically distinct from the FGFR/BMP pro-osteogenic-drive routes.
